title: Anthropic Paid $10B to a Startup Nobody Knew Existed
description:
Anthropic just dropped $10B on a startup thats less than a year old 🔥

It's called Volta, founded this year by ex managers from Brookfield fund. The deal: 6 years, 133 MW in Norway, on a site that used to be a Bitcoin mine, Nvidia Vera Rubin chips coming online through march 2027.

Clouds can't keep up, so labs are just building thier own suppliers now 😅

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
